shared_elements: horizontal bands/registers of repeated signs or motifs
linear hatch or stripe infill on some forms
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include schematic repeated signs arranged in bands/registers, with some rounded/rectangular motifs and animal-like figures among them. The major difference is that A is dominated by a framed rectangular field with a large central disc and border of glyph-like panels, while B shows stacked relief registers with prominent profile animals/figures and no comparable central disc or enclosing border scheme.
